headlines.title: Earnings round-up: Sandisk tops estimates, while Starbucks & Reddit fall short
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Breaking Business News Reporter Jake Conley takes a closer look at several companies that reported earnings results on Thursday, including Sandisk (SNDK), Starbucks (SBUX), and Reddit (RDDT).

headlines.title: Sandisk tops Q1 estimates and guides higher, sets 8-for-1 stock split
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) reported fiscal first-quarter results that topped Wall Street expectations on Thursday and lifted its near-term guidance, propelled by surging memory demand for artificial intelligence workloads.

headlines.title: SanDisk Is Sold Out for the Rest of the Decade, and Is Splitting Its $1,300 Stock 8-for-1
headlines.summary: SanDisk just told investors it cannot make enough chips to meet demand through the end of the decade, yet the stock still sold off hard. A massive stock split and record margins did nothing to calm the skeptics.

headlines.title: SNDK Q1 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and Supply Discipline
headlines.summary: Sandisk's Q1 earnings beat estimates as AI-driven datacenter demand surges, while long-term customer deals and disciplined supply management support growth.

headlines.title: Sandisk Beats Fiscal Q1 Earnings Estimates, Raises Outlook and Announces 8-for-1 Stock Split
headlines.summary: Sandisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK) reported stronger-than-expected fiscal first-quarter earnings and revenue, supported by accelerating demand for high-performance memory products used in artificial intelligence applications and data centres. The semiconductor company’s results exceeded Wall Street forecasts, while its second-quarter guidance also surpassed analyst expectations.

description: Sandisk Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells data storage devices and solutions using NAND flash technology in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Asia, and internationally. The company provides solid state drives for desktop and notebook PCs, gaming consoles, and set top boxes; and flash-based embedded storage products for mobile phones, tablets, notebook PCs and other portable and wearable devices, automotive applications, Internet of Things, industrial, and connected home applications, as well as removable cards, universal serial bus drives, and wafers and components. It sells its products to computer manufacturers and original equipment manufacturers, datacenters, private cloud customers, cloud service providers, resellers, distributors, and retailers through its sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. Sandisk Corporation was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Milpitas, California.
